title: Chain-level decoupling of the physical heterotic $G_2$ deformation complex at the standard embedding
summary: The physical deformation complex of heterotic $G_2$ compactifications couples instanton deformations to geometric fields and their first-order $α'$ corrections. We give an explicit chain-level decoupling of its first-order coefficient complex at the minimal standard embedding, where the gauge bundle is the tangent bundle, the gauge connection is the Levi--Civita connection, and the background $G_2$ structure is torsion-free.
